title: FM27 Skins — Releases & Platform Compatibility
description: FM27 skins checked 4 November 2026: two author releases, stated Steam platform paths, bundle installation and patch recovery guidance.
meta: Updated 4 November 2026 · Paid Launch Preview · Author pages checked; platform claims are reported as stated, not tested in-game by this site.
body:
The free FM27 Preview ended on 3 November; paid Launch Preview access continues until full launch on 10 November. The two author pages list FM27 releases, but neither confirms support for a specific game build or the full-launch build. A download label or example path does not prove that a package works on every platform.

Super League Turkey also lists Linux Steam paths (Proton/native and Flatpak), ending in StandaloneWindows64. Its instructions identify three files: ui-mainmenu-assets_assets_all.bundle, ui-styles_assets_default.bundle and ui-tactics_assets_all.bundle. The page still says to close Football Manager 26 in places; use the FM27 paths shown in its instructions. Neither package has been tested by this site, and this page does not rank skins.

Super League Turkey: Steam installation paths

The author's Windows example ends in Football Manager 27/fm_Data/StreamingAssets/aa/StandaloneWindows64/. The macOS example ends in Football Manager 27/fm.app/Contents/Resources/Data/StreamingAssets/aa/StandaloneOSX/. Open your own FM27 installation in Steam to locate that suffix; custom library locations can change the earlier folders. These examples apply to Super League Turkey, not automatically to Priisek.

Install, back up and restore

  1. Recheck the selected author page and package for your platform and game build. Extract the archive; do not copy the compressed archive itself into the game directory.
  2. Close FM27 and Steam. Find the FM27 installation opened by Steam. Use the OS-specific Super League path above; the Priisek page's readable installation section currently gives no specific path, so do not infer one from the other skin.
  3. Before changing files, copy the originals to a separate folder and record the game build/date. For Super League Turkey, back up all three named bundle files. Apply only the selected package's files, keeping filenames and locations unchanged.
  4. After launch, check the main menu, tactics, squad/player screens and match day. If a screen breaks or a game patch changes the files, close the game and restore the matching originals. Recheck the author page for an FM27 update that names your build before reinstalling.

Can an FM26 skin be used in FM27?

Only when its author explicitly provides an FM27-compatible release or instructions for your build. A logo or facepack compatibility notice does not establish that interface assets work.

FM27 skins FAQ

Do these skins have confirmed Game Pass or Epic support?

No. The cited download/path evidence is Steam-specific; neither skin page names Game Pass or Epic. Do not assume a Steam path applies to another edition.

Will an installed skin survive a game patch?

Not necessarily. A patch may replace modified assets or leave an older bundle incompatible. Restore the matching originals, then check for an author update that covers your build before applying files again.

Which releases are listed?

The two releases and their latest dates are shown in the table above. Neither author page confirms support for the 10 November full-launch build.
